title: How to give a bot a command
content: Bot commands are plain words sent to the bot by whisper or in party or raid chat, for example follow, stay, attack, summon, leave. The message has to start with the command word; a polite sentence such as can you follow me does nothing. The bot does not answer a command in words, it just does it and says a short line like Following or Staying. Only the player who invited the bot to the group can command it. These command words are on this module's blacklist, so a message that starts with one is never answered by the bot's chat AI: whispering just follow makes the bot follow.
keywords: how do i command a bot
what can i tell the bots

title: How to get a bot to join your group
content: Whisper the bot the word invite and it sends you a group invitation; accept it and it becomes your party member and follows your orders. A bot refuses if it is more than 5 levels above you (unless you share a guild), or if it is in a battleground queue or its group is full; then it only chats. You can also invite a bot yourself with the normal group invite on its name.
keywords: how do i get you in my group

title: How to bring a bot to you
content: Whisper or say summon in party chat and the bot is teleported next to you, from any distance, as long as it is in your group. If you would rather have it walk to you, say follow.

title: How to make a bot follow you
content: Say follow (whisper or party chat) and the bot follows you around and stops being passive; it answers Following. This is how to make a bot come with you while you quest. Say stay to stop it again.

title: How to make a bot stay or wait
content: Say stay and the bot stops where it is and holds that spot; it answers Staying. Say follow when you want it to come along again. There is no timed wait command: stay holds the bot until you tell it otherwise.

title: How to make a bot attack your target
content: Select the enemy you want, then say attack. The bot attacks whatever you currently have targeted; with no target it says You have no target. The pull command works the same way for pulling a mob. Bots also fight on their own when something attacks you or them.

title: How to make a bot flee or run away
content: Say flee to make the bot stop fighting, go passive and stay close to you; it answers Fleeing, or says it is too far away if it is. Say runaway (or warning) to have it run away from the fight instead. Say follow afterwards to bring it back to normal.

title: How to make a bot passive or aggressive
content: There is no standalone passive or aggressive command. To change how it fights, send co +passive (do not start fights) or co -passive, co +aggressive, and nc +passive for outside combat. The flee command also sets passive. A message that is only the word passive or aggressive does not change anything.

title: How to control what a bot loots
content: Say ll all, ll normal, ll gray or ll disenchant to set which items the bot picks up, and ll ? to ask what it is doing. Say loot all to make it loot everything nearby right now. Bots that joined you from the world cannot have loot changed through nc, only through ll.

title: How to make a bot leave your group
content: Whisper or say leave and the bot leaves your group (only its master can do this). It also leaves by itself when you leave the party.

title: Can a bot lead the way?
content: No. There is no command that makes a bot lead you somewhere. Bots only follow the player; the player leads. A bot cannot guide you to a quest or a place, so say you do not know the way, or suggest asking in general chat or looking at the map. The word lead is not a command. go ? only makes the bot tell where it is, and go travel followed by a place name sends the bot off on its own.

title: Healer, tank and damage roles for bots
content: There is no command to change a bot's role; its role comes from its class and talent spec. To address only some bots, start the message with @tank, @heal, @dps, @melee or @ranged, for example @heal follow, and only bots of that role react. Say tank attack to have a tank take your target, and focus heal to make healers concentrate on set targets.

title: Other useful bot commands
content: Useful commands, each sent on its own: stats shows the bot's gold, bag space and repair cost; quests lists its quests; accept followed by a quest link makes it accept that quest from a nearby NPC; talk makes it talk to the nearest NPC; autogear equips the best gear it can; talents help lists what it can do about its talents; release and revive handle dying; help prints the command list; who tells its spec and where it is; reset botAI resets its behavior. Commands only work for the bot's master.
keywords: what else can i tell you
